key_insight: MARVEL improves out-of-distribution detection in long-tailed medical classification by combining margin-aware NvMF experts with a dedicated outlier expert.
clinical_relevance: This could help diagnostic AI defer unfamiliar cases to clinicians more reliably, reducing overconfident mistakes in real-world workflows.
method: Uses a nonlinear von Mises-Fisher classifier to model non-linear decision boundaries.
Splits learning across multiple margin-aware experts to better handle imbalanced label distributions.
Adds an explicit outlier expert to separate in-distribution from out-of-distribution samples.
evidence_signal: The method was evaluated on RFMiD, ISIC2019, and NCTCRC, with reported mean FPR95 reductions of 8.45%, 13.02%, and 36.90% versus state-of-the-art methods.
watch_item: The gains should be interpreted cautiously because deployment performance may vary across hospitals, scanners, and real clinical OOD shifts not covered in the study.
paper_title: MARVEL: Margin-Aware Robust von Mises-Fischer Expert Learning for Long-Tailed Out-of-Distribution Detection
